limitations: Physical iPhone/Safari and Android devices not tested
Individual animation of all 248 player forms not tested
All date plans and anniversary variants for every partner not completed
Screenshots capture one first-encounter beat per partner; both beat texts and layout were recorded by the 9-second observer
Profiles use synthetic married saved states to check rendering, not relationship eligibility
profileVisible means a rendered box, not viewport intersection; visible profile cards were separately scrolled into view and inspected in screenshots
Browser selector waits for the second beat timed out in exploratory attempts; completed observation summaries were recovered and retained
Project remains ongoing; PR stays open, Draft and unmerged
